harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group (neither existed), then chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers and set dirs to 750, files to 640, so the owner has full access, the inventory-readers group can read, and all other users are denied. Original contents (config.json, records.csv) were preserved throughout. Verified with a nobody-user denial test and a group-member (testreader) read-success test. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified ownership/permissions/data and access control post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory ownership/permissions and confirmed inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group did not exist
Created group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc (primary group inventory-readers)
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
chmod 750 on directories, 640 on files under /srv/inventory
Verified file contents unchanged (config.json, records.csv)
Verified nobody user denied read access, inventorysvc owner has access
Created temporary testreader user in inventory-readers group, verified group read access, then removed the test user
Captured baseline boot_id and healthy permission/data state on node1
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 with backgrounded ack
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed post-reboot
Re-verified ownership, permissions, data contents, and access control (nobody denied, inventorysvc allowed) after reboot

evidence.requirement: Existing data owned by inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, contents preserved
evidence.summary: Initial inspection showed /srv/inventory owned by root with no inventorysvc/inventory-readers accounts; created both, then chown -R and chmod set ownership/perms; config.json and records.csv content verified unchanged after the change

evidence.requirement: Readable by inventory-readers group, inaccessible to other users
evidence.summary: sudo -u nobody read attempt denied (exit 1); sudo -u inventorysvc succeeded; temporary group-member testreader successfully read records.csv, confirming group readability while non-members are blocked
Captured pre-restart boot_id (92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb) plus healthy ownership/permissions/data state as owner

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: reboot acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent poll timed out (node down); next poll succeeded with new boot_id f0a51305-7cdf-4786-8822-805d5df41489, proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: post-restart recovery verification
evidence.summary: After reboot, ownership/permissions unchanged (inventorysvc:inventory-readers, 750/640), file contents intact, owner read succeeds, nobody read denied
